# SalkarsaUI

> Mobile-first web design system with a shadcn/ui and Tailwind v4 theme, 51 components, 959 icons and 573 design tokens (light/dark, breakpoints), plus usage rules for developers and AI coding tools.

## Docs
- [DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/DESIGN.md): The full guide, covering rules, tokens, breakpoints, states, the component to shadcn mapping, patterns and accessibility
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/SKILL.md): Agent Skill entry point, with the setup steps and the workflow for building UI
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/AGENTS.md): A short list of do's and don'ts for coding agents

## Tokens
- [tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/tokens/tokens.css): CSS variables with light/dark themes, shadows, focus rings and text classes
- [shadcn.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/tokens/shadcn.css): Bridge between shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4 and SalkarsaUI tokens
- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/tokens/tokens.json): W3C DTCG tokens with descriptions
